title: Span bracket
description: A bracket drawn inside a chart's SVG over the columns of the selected span: a bark hairline with turned-up ends and the span's name over it. Charts that take a span prop add SPAN pixels of room above the plot for it.

anatomy.description: A <g data-slot="span-bracket"> holding the path and the label text; positioned by x0 and x1 in the chart's own pixel space, from its top edge.

usage: Render it as the first child of the chart's SVG and translate the plot down by SPAN so the bracket has its own row.
Snap x0 and x1 to the first and last selected columns' edges; the bracket rounds them to whole pixels itself.
The label is the span's name (a season, a month range), set in the eyebrow type: mono, 2xs, uppercase.
